mintAuthority.headline: Asset-backed shares have no arbitrary mint; separate curator and allocator Safes control lending parameters.
mintAuthority.summary: Local share issuance is asset-backed and accounting-mediated; the parameter administrator does not have arbitrary share mint authority. Base USDS issuance remains inherited from usds-sky.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: The immutable VaultV2 enter function transfers USDS from the depositor before creating the corresponding shares; deposit and mint both use that path. The only other share creation is formula-mediated management/performance fee issuance against accounted assets, with both fees zero at Ethereum block 26197300 (2026-10-15T10:25:11Z). No local owner, curator or allocator entrypoint can mint arbitrary unbacked shares or authorize such a minter, and the fixed vault code has no upgrade path. Curation changes adapters, allocation caps, fees and routing, not a native issuance ceiling. Parent USDS issuance authority belongs to usds-sky and is inherited separately through the serial-claim dependency; this bounded verdict concerns only local wrapper-share issuance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197300 (2026-10-15T10:25:11Z), this Safe is owner, curator and sentinel, but isAllocator is false. It is 2-of-3 with the enumerated owners, no enabled modules (pagination ends at the sentinel), zero guard and module guard, and the standard compatibility fallback handler. addAdapter, increaseAbsoluteCap and increaseRelativeCap have 259200-second timelocks; allocator and fee setters have zero delay. All share-transfer and asset-exit gate setters, and setAdapterRegistry, are abdicated. The deposit gate setter remains callable. Current registry is 0x3696c5eae4a7ffd04ea163564571e9cd8ed9364e. The adapter-wide absolute allocation cap is uint128 maximum and relative cap 20%; each current market/collateral relative cap is 10%. PT-sUSDS absolute market/collateral caps are 5 million USDS; the other current absolute caps are uint128 maximum. These are adjustable allocation caps, not native issuance limits. forceDeallocatePenalty is 0.2%, with a 604800-second setter delay; adapter burnShares and setSkimRecipient have 259200-second delays. Pending executable proposals and signer independence are not established by getter reads. Pinned RPC: https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/.

controls.evidence: Morpho's indexed role roster identifies this allocator, independently confirmed by isAllocator=true and isSentinel=false at Ethereum block 26197300 (2026-10-15T10:25:11Z). Safe getter/storage reads show 1-of-3 signing, no enabled modules, zero guard/module guard and the standard compatibility fallback handler. The allocator can allocate and deallocate within approved adapters and caps, set maxRate and change liquidityAdapter/data without a timelock; it cannot raise caps or mint arbitrary native shares. liquidityAdapter is currently zero, so ordinary redeem/withdraw uses idle USDS unless a separate deallocation occurs. Offchain signer custody, independence and a historical permission/pending-operation census are not established. Pinned RPC: https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/.
